text: dsh-reference-render 是面向 DSH Web 对话的结构化资源引用渲染原语，为插件和宿主提供统一的引用描述符、行内 chip 与交互契约。它识别 `[标签](dsh-ref:<kind>:<id>)` 格式，将正文切分为文本和引用段，供宿主分别渲染；chip 可展示色点、色条和图标，并可连接悬浮内容与打开事件。host 部分还会把引用书写指引加入 system prompt。适合需要在 DSH 对话中展示其他插件资源引用的集成开发者；完整会话接线和引用内容由宿主或消费插件提供。

dsh-reference-render adds structured references to DSH Web. It splits `[label](dsh-ref:<kind>:<id>)` links into text and reference segments, renders decorated inline chips, and exposes hover and open events. Host or consuming plugins supply conversation wiring and reference content.
想让 DSH 对话里的资源链接显示成行内引用标签。
怎么把带 kind 和 id 的 DSH 引用链接转换成统一描述符？
我希望引用 chip 能显示状态色点、边条和图标。
需要让用户悬停在引用上时打开一个预览面板。
想在用户点击引用时把打开请求交给对应插件处理。
如何给 DSH 的回答加入资源引用格式提示？
I want DSH resource links to render as inline reference chips.
How can a plugin receive an event when someone activates a reference?
dsh-reference-render 的功能「引用链接切分」：将 `[标签](dsh-ref:<kind>:<id>)` 识别为引用段，并保留其前后的普通文本段，供宿主选择对应渲染方式。
dsh-reference-render 的功能「引用 chip」：把引用描述符呈现为可键盘操作的行内按钮，显示标签，并可附加点、条或图标装饰。
dsh-reference-render 的功能「悬停预览状态」：指针停留引用后延迟打开预览，离开后经过宽限时间关闭，并向内容提供者传递可取消信号。
dsh-reference-render 的功能「引用打开事件」：chip 激活时可将描述符与键盘或指针来源通过 reference/open serial 事件交给消费插件处理。
dsh-reference-render 的功能「引用书写指引」：host 插件把 dsh-ref 链接格式和引用真实资源的规则加入 system prompt，可按配置覆盖 kind 参考词表。
dsh-reference-render 提供渲染原语与交互契约；对话组件接线和引用内容认领由消费宿主或其他插件实现，单独安装不会自动接管所有会话内容。

Domain-neutral **structured reference rendering** for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) conversations: `[label](dsh-ref:<kind>:<id>)` becomes an inline chip — dot/bar/icon decorations on either side, hover preview, click-to-open. The renderer understands **no business domain**; content comes from other plugins through frozen contracts.

dsh-reference-render README · Install：npm registry publication is pending; install from this repository in the meantime:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/popingalex/dsh-reference-render.git
cd dsh-reference-render && pnpm install && pnpm build && npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-reference-render-0.1.0.tgz
```

Once published: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-reference-render@0.1.0`.
dsh-reference-render README · Install：Tested on DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 only — see [COMPATIBILITY.md](./COMPATIBILITY.md) and [docs/install.md](./docs/install.md) (demo bundles, troubleshooting).

dsh-reference-render README · Usage：**Emit** — a plain GFM link becomes a chip; without the plugin it degrades to an ordinary link: ```text Build completed. See [RP-42](dsh-ref:report:RP-42) for details. ``` **Decorate** — a content plugin claims a reference and supplies dot/bar/icon decorations for either side, up to 3 per side. An icon without a color follows the text color; `mode: 'image'` renders an original-color ``. Unclaimed references stay plain chips — hover and click are no-ops.

dsh-reference-render README · Usage：**Contribute** — two chain slots and one serial event:

```ts
ctx.effect(() => ctx.slots.inject('reference.hover.content', () =>
  ctx.slots.register({ name: 'reference.hover.content',
    select: (owner) => isOurs(owner.descriptor) ? {} : null }, MyHoverCard)))

- Skill for agents/plugins: [skill/dsh-reference-rendering](./skill/dsh-reference-rendering/SKILL.md) — prompt-only emission rules, or full plugin integration
- Examples: [conversation-demo](https://github.com/popingalex/dsh-reference-render/tree/main/examples/conversation-demo) (wiring) · [sidebar-demo](https://github.com/popingalex/dsh-reference-render/tree/main/examples/sidebar-demo) (content claimant) · [minimal](https://github.com/popingalex/dsh-reference-render/tree/main/examples/minimal) / [contribution](https://github.com/popingalex/dsh-reference-render/tree/main/examples/contribution) (source walkthroughs)
- Reproduce the screenshots locally: [docs/local-demo.md](./docs/local-demo.md)
dsh-reference-render README · Reference：The renderer owns no business truth (`View ≠ Truth`): unclaimed references stay plain chips, and removing the plugin leaves the host unchanged.
